title: A merge trial that fails only on a test with an open flaky item merges the candidate
description: Run the real loop cycle against a real temporary Postgres control plane and a scratch bare Git remote: with an open "Flaky check on main" item for a test, a candidate whose merge trial fails only that test merges instead of being sent back, and the flaky item gains a note naming the candidate.

steps.name: Merge a candidate whose trial fails only on a known-flaky test through the real loop
